response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_quantity, inv.relative_gap, inv.avg_quantity - overall.overall_avg AS quantity_above_average FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_quantity > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY quantity_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
